 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Mahajan
 Order

1. The present bail application is filed by the applicant seeking regular bail in FIR No. 77/2023 dated 14.01.2023, registered at Police Station Nihal Vihar for the offences under Sections 498A/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
3. The learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State accepts notice.

4. Let status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
5. Let nominal roll be requisitioned from the concerned Jail Superintendent before the next date of hearing.

6. List on 04.09.2025.
AMIT MAHAJAN, J AUGUST 5, 2025 DU
